title: Create the asset staging stamp directory on clean builds
body: The first queued clean Release build ran as bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent rimleak --resource build --label rimleak:build-release-base -- cmake --build VIXEN/build --parallel 4 and failed with exit 2 when cmake -E touch tried to write build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets/167702914e53754e.stamp before its parent existed. I added explicit creation in VIXEN/cmake/VixenAssets.cmake, reconfigured, and the same clean build passed. Consolidate stamp-directory creation in the shared staging helper so new build trees need no manual setup.

title: Resolve native capture output paths before changing application directories
body: The queued capture command passed reports/rimleak-visual/captures/before, but run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh launches apps after cd into their runtime dir; the app then resolves the relative capture path there and stbi_write_png fails. Passing the absolute worktree capture path succeeds. Make the script canonicalize capture_root before launching child apps.

title: Recover missing pending history files before queue admission
body: The queued command bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent rimleak --resource build --label rimleak:build-balanced-hit-tolerance -- cmake --build VIXEN/build --target test_baked_vs_virtual_parity --parallel 4 failed before admission with exit 2 because awk could not open /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-history-summary.log.pending. Queue --status remained usable and retrying the same build as rimleak:build-balanced-hit-tolerance-retry passed. Recover or tolerate a missing transient pending summary so a history race does not reject build work.

title: Keep native capture witnesses alive through shader recompiles
body: The failed command was bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent rimleak --resource test --label rimleak:capture-after -- env DISPLAY=:0 VIXEN_CACHE_DIR=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/rimleak/VIXEN/.tmp/cache-rimleak-after bash tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh VIXEN/build/binaries VIXEN VIXEN/build/binaries vixen_editor /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/rimleak/reports/rimleak-visual/captures/after. It exited 75 with STALL_KILLED after 185 seconds. The helper uses a fixed 180-second app timeout and redirects child output to editor.log; frames 5 and 45 were written, but later frames were not. Its required CTest offscreen capture producer passed and preserved the frame-5 evidence. Provide a capture mode that survives expected shader recompiles or reports its partial sequence without stalling the queued witness.

title: Provide a reusable SDF ray trace probe contract
body: To explain R464, the test hand-wired VIXEN_RIMLEAK_TRACE shader instrumentation, binding 48, a 16-word per-pixel SSBO record, CPU decoding, and selected-pixel trace probes in VIXEN/libraries/RenderGraph/tests/Nodes/test_baked_vs_virtual_parity.cpp. There was no reusable diagnostic surface to report termination, final SDF/gradient, step count, interval, and occupancy grid level per ray. Consolidate per-pixel SDF trace diagnostics behind a shared test/debug contract.
